Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Demotion]]: Darth Vader chokes Admiral Motti with the Force, without touching him, at a meeting of the Death Star's commanders in ''Star Wars'', after telling him "I find your lack of faith disturbing."

Source: [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/File:I_find_your_lack_of_faith_disturbing.png I find your lack of faith disturbing.png], Wookieepedia (a frame from ''Star Wars'' (1977); 1280 by 820 pixels). Reduced to 800 by 512 pixels and converted to JPEG. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170826031312/http://starwars.wikia.com/wiki/File:I_find_your_lack_of_faith_disturbing.png Internet Archive], 26 August 2017. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: 9d3eb6e99dc9f923b0c1a27ed99d0d9b95c509eda4acf11e09db86c451b00c52.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single reduced-size still from ''Star Wars'' (1977), © Lucasfilm Ltd., used only to show the scene the card's lore refers to, beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the film or harm its market, and no free image of the scene exists.
